newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to sell 50 pct Iberia by end 1999 - agency.
newsitem.headline: Spain to sell 50 pct Iberia by end 1999 - agency.

text.p: Spain's Industry Minister Josep Pique said on Monday the government was aiming to float around 50 percent of state airline Iberia by the end of 1999, local agency Europa Press reported.

Pique told reporters in Barcelona that around half of the company's capital would be sold "during 1998 or at the latest in 1999, depending on the situation in the markets, so that at the end of this term, Iberia will be a private company".
Following the announcement of preliminary agreements with British Airways and American Airlines on an alliance, Pique said the two airlines would take stakes in Iberia by the end of the year.
Pique said the new alliance could prompt further falls in tariffs. "It could increase international competition and free traffic (leading to) better service and prices".
